text:
deploy-bot: Starting prod deploy window for service=embedder v=2.14.0 -> v=2.15.0. Canary traffic 5% for 10m. Release notes: https://redwood.in/release/2.15.0

kira: Thanks — I'll watch the SLO dashboard. Tagging @mike on observability.

mike: on it. I'll keep an eye on p95 and embed-5xx. Spinning up a snapshot: `dash links/embeds/slo?from=now-15m`

anika: quick heads-up: this build includes a quantization kernel tweak; watch kv-cache hit rate and memory churn.

deploy-bot: Canary health update (t=2m): p95 +12% vs baseline, embed-5xx 0.02% -> 0.08%, region eu-west-1 shows most of the errors.

leo: saw a short burst of OOM-ish traces in eu-west (stack id 0x7f4c). Dump looks like tensor allocator failing alloc on step 3. Paging oncall.

pagerbot: @oncall-team Incident created INC-4221 — investigating autoscaler/allocator. https://redwood.in/inc/4221

kira: can we avoid a full rollback by pinning eu-west to the previous variant and continuing rollout elsewhere?

mike: yep — routing pin is safe. Running: `rbctl route set --service embedder --region eu-west-1 --version 2.14.0`

deploy-bot: Route update applied for eu-west-1 -> pinned to v=2.14.0. Canary traffic still 5% in other regions.

anika: checking metrics now: p95 back down to +2% outside eu-west. Global 5xx settled to ~0.03%.

kira: decision: continue rollout with eu-west pinned to 2.14.0. Update release notes to call out the regional pin and quantization follow-up.

leo: I'll open an infra postmortem item to track allocator root cause — not blocking this window but high priority to fix.

mike: adding a temporary alert on embed-5xx delta > 50 per million over baseline for 5m: `monitorctl create --alert embed-5xx-spike --threshold 0.0005 --window 5m`

deploy-bot: Canary complete in remaining regions. Promoting to 50% traffic over next 20m.

kira: great — thanks everyone. Marking deploy window as in-progress; post-deploy audit and release summary after 30m stable.

pagerbot: Reminder — post-deploy runbook checklist: https://redwood.in/runbooks/deploy-post-audit (check SLO diffs, trace samples, error budget)

mike: I'll keep sampling traces and will post a follow-up if any regressed prompts appear.

kira: TL;DR: we avoided rollback by regionally pinning, set an alert, and created INC-4221 + infra follow-up. Continue watch.
